catalog.name: Vampire Village
catalog.summary: Hidden-role social deduction: vampires hunt by night, the village votes by day.

vampire.role.vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.role.vampire.blurb: Each night, agree with your pack on one villager to bite. By day, blend in.
vampire.role.villager.name: Villager
vampire.role.villager.blurb: You have no night power — your voice and your vote are your weapons.
vampire.role.seer.name: Seer
vampire.role.seer.blurb: Each night, look into one player. At dawn you learn their true role.
vampire.role.doctor.name: Doctor
vampire.role.doctor.blurb: Each night, protect one player from attacks — never the same player two nights in a row. You may protect yourself.
vampire.role.hunter.name: Hunter
vampire.role.hunter.blurb: From the second night you may shoot someone. You have two bullets. Kill an innocent villager and you die of remorse.
vampire.role.survivor.name: Survivor
vampire.role.survivor.blurb: Raise one of your three shields on the nights you choose — each one stops an attack. Stay alive to the end and you win, whoever else does.
vampire.role.jester.name: Jester
vampire.role.jester.blurb: You want the village to hang you. If they do, you win. Die at night and you lose.
vampire.goal.vampires: Win when the vampires are as many as the village.
vampire.goal.survivor: Be alive when the game ends.
vampire.goal.jester: Get the village to hang you.

vampire.lobby.rule1: Night: the vampires choose someone to bite, while the seer, the doctor, the hunter and the survivor use their powers in secret.
vampire.lobby.rule2: Dawn: the village learns who died — and what they were.
vampire.lobby.rule3: Day: talk it out, then vote. A majority of the living hangs someone; without one, nobody leaves.
vampire.lobby.rule4: The village wins when every vampire is dead. The vampires win once they are as many as the village.
